_meta.description: Star Citizen ship cargo grid dataset for cargo loading planner.
_meta.data_source: Cargo Grid Viewer (sc-cargo.space) community-maintained dataset, current as of patch 4.4.x (May 2026); cross-referenced against starcitizen.tools.
_meta.grid_axes: columns = grid width (transverse); rows = grid length (along ship length); layers = vertical stack height. Each cell holds 1 SCU.
_meta.scu_in_bay_note: scu_in_bay is the SCU contribution of that bay assuming 1 SCU per cell; sum equals total_scu.
